test_title: PYST 41: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 13 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

After the first defeats he had to ________ from France with the empress.
solution: The correct answer is: **Flee**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • '**Flee**' means to run away from a place or situation of danger. (किसी खतरे की स्थिति या स्थान से भाग जाना) • **Example**: *The sight of the approaching storm made them flee.* • The sentence suggests that the person faced defeats and had to leave France with the empress, indicating a situation of danger or threat. • The verb 'flee' is in past tense form 'had to flee', indicating that the action of leaving France was already completed. • The sentence uses the preposition 'from' after the verb 'flee', indicating the origin of the departure. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**. **Complete sentence**: *After the first defeats he had to flee __from France with the empress.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Fleet **means a group of ships or vehicles. (जहाजों या वाहनों का समूह) • **Fling **means to throw or hurt something with force. (किसी चीज़ को बलपूर्वक फेंकना या चोट पहुँचाना) • **Flea **is an insect that feeds on the blood of mammals and birds. (एक कीट जो स्तनधारियों और पक्षियों का खून खाता है) 32:T5f9, The correct answer is: **Decide to do something that is difficult.**
